businessGoal: To allow visitors to browse and explore all available products.

scenarios.goal: Verify that a grid of product cards is displayed on the home page.
Verify that each product card shows a product image, product name, and product price.
Verify that clicking on a product card navigates to the product detail page for that product.

clarifications: No information on what happens if there are no products available to display.
No details on the layout or design of the product cards.
